physical_model.model: Gunnerus sealed main hull plus simplified deckhouse contact envelopes
physical_model.mass_basis: Derived from closed visual-hull displacement at the declared 2.7 m draft; not measured vessel mass.
limitations: Approximate sealed hull and convex deckhouse envelopes, not production CAD or internal flooding.
Masts, rails, cranes and propulsion appendages remain visual-only.
Drainage/freeing ports and local panel flexibility are not resolved; deck water and impact loads are qualitative diagnostics.
Mass, KG and radii of gyration remain declared assumptions from the prior pilot.
Froude scale does not preserve full-scale Reynolds number.
physical_model.contact_geometry: Manifold union of existing main hull and two convex envelopes fitted to MIT visual deckhouse vertices.
physical_model.mass_geometry_policy: Mass, CG and inertia are the unchanged assumed loading condition; adding upper contact geometry does not add a second structural mass.

wave_input: First-order crest-focused JONSWAP/NewWave piston; measured SPH height and breaking are commissioning outputs.

propulsion.basis: Assumed diagnostic force, not a calibrated propulsion operating point

limitations: Approximate sealed hull and convex deckhouse envelopes, not production CAD or internal flooding.
Masts, rails, cranes and propulsion appendages remain visual-only.
Drainage/freeing ports and local panel flexibility are not resolved; deck water and impact loads are qualitative diagnostics.
Mass, KG and radii of gyration remain declared assumptions from the prior pilot.
Froude scale does not preserve full-scale Reynolds number.
Coarse pilot; not validated resistance, propulsion efficiency or impact pressure.
Finite tank with downstream damping; later reflections and finite depth remain part of this setup.
Matched force and initial speed do not maintain equal speeds, so differences are not equal-speed added resistance.
Assumed thrust does not add propeller momentum to the water; no actuator disk is present.
16-second transient with a focused wave packet; no extra downward body force is prescribed.
focus_basis: Initial station aligned with the breaking-front region measured in the empty tank; actual ship motion remains free.
interpretation: Linear target crest above still water is not crest-to-trough wave height or significant wave height.
encounter_selection: Empty-tank gauges x=12 and 14 m: H=1.364094 and 1.47286 m; initial station 5.5 m approximates the calm-trajectory bow encounter at x=12 m, t=7.89 s. Subsequent ship motion is entirely free.
comparison_to_previous: Wave target amplitude 0.85 to 1.15 m; depth 2 to 3 m; initial station 2 to 5.5 m. Hull, mass, inertia, thrust and dp unchanged. More motion is a hypothesis, not a prescribed result.
